content: TASK-099 baselined v0.4 as a plugin-first Requirements and Lifecycle Graph. Core stays compact and gains isolated plugin/element/relation/validator/query foundations; @archmap/lifecycle installs Schema + Relations + Validation + Views. The vertical slice is delivered through TASK-100 Core registry, TASK-101 lifecycle package, TASK-102 parse/normalize, TASK-103 diagnostics, TASK-104 query/trace, TASK-105 three lifecycle views, TASK-106 acceptance, and TASK-107 periodic QIF. GitHub v0.3.0 is released; npm 0.3.0 remains deferred for later OTP completion.
